entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to return my VeloBand tracker. It's just not working right.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. The GPS is a joke. It tracks me a full quarter-mile off from where I actually am. Honestly, for the price, this thing is garbage.

I certainly understand your frustration with inaccurate GPS. That's a core feature and it should be working perfectly. I'd be happy to transfer you to our technical support team. They have advanced tools to diagnose and resolve that kind of issue, often right over the phone.
Oh, I really don't have time for a big technical call. I've already tried turning it off and on. I just want money back for it, that's all. Can we please just process a refund?
I understand you'd prefer a simple refund. Let me just pull up your order details to check the policy for you... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 17 days ago, on December 24th.
For that specific model, there's a strict 10-day return window for a refund. Since we're on day 17, the system won't allow me to process a return directly.
But it's not like I just changed my mind, it's broken. The policy shouldn't apply if the product is defective, right?

You are correct, a verified defect is handled differently, usually under warranty. That's why the required first step is to engage with our technical team to verify the fault. Without that verification, my system defaults to the standard 10-day return policy for the Pulse.
I just... I can't believe this. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I buy all my gear here. I saved up for this tracker and I really needed that money back. I just feel so let down.

I do see your long history with us, and I sincerely appreciate your loyalty. I wish I had a different answer, but my hands are tied by the policy on this specific device. The only path forward is to confirm the issue with our tech specialists. They can authorize a warranty replacement if it's found to be faulty, which would get you a working device at no cost.
So you're saying there's no way to get a refund? I don't want a replacement, I just want out. This whole experience has been so disappointing.
I'm afraid a refund is not an option at this stage. I am truly sorry that we couldn't resolve this the way you had hoped today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. I guess that's it. Thanks for nothing.
